1. (Currently amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder __comprising premixed solder paste__; and a solvent.

2. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface __and the thermally conductive binder comprises premixed solder paste__.

3. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface __and the thermally conductive binder comprises premixed solder paste__.
